summary: This document defines a new Uniform Resource Name (URN) namespace for hardware device identifiers. It gives sensor data streams, storage systems and equipment inventories a general way to write down a device's identity as a URN. That representation can then be passed along between applications that need to know which device is meant.

eli5.summary: Every gadget needs a name tag that anyone can read the same way. This document invents a standard style of name tag for hardware, so different programs can talk about the same gadget without mixing it up.

questions: how to represent hardware device identity as a urn
